entries.text: TPC-Havoc 1_v7 now translates for PostgreSQL (multi-argument UNNEST) and DataFusion (folds computed in the query that builds the lists), and its DataFusion skip is removed; pg-duckdb and pg-mooncake keep a documented skip because DuckDB rejects the multi-argument UNNEST, and platforms with no list translation (ClickHouse, Redshift, T-SQL, StarRocks, Doris, SingleStore, QuestDB, Databend, Snowpark Connect) carry a documented 1_v7 skip. SQLite no longer fails TPC-Havoc 6_v2 and 14_v2 with a syntax error on GROUP BY (), and writes a global aggregate's HAVING as a subquery filter. TPC-DS OBT Q36, Q70, Q86 (alias inside an ORDER BY expression) and Q2, Q78 (round on a double) now run on PostgreSQL. The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.15 to 30.24.0.16, fork commit fe0474baf13151fbacd4d86bc7f6c26805e3ab61. No published bundle is affected.
